result.title: feat(site): rebuild the site around a working demo
result.author: kjj6198
result.body: ## Overview Rebuilds the marketing site from scratch for the new mark and DESIGN.md: a light site on the Hina palette with a working demo as the hero. It follows the logo and theme work in the "Redesign HinaCode logo as SVG owl" thread. The demo is a working copy of the app in Hina Light, not a recording. Four threads run on their own timelines once it scrolls into view. Claude Code asks to run a command (allow, or deny with a note), Codex asks which CSV delimiter to use, and the Vite thread has its failing check handed to the agent by pull request watch, then fixes and pushes it. You can steer a running turn, queue a follow-up, switch threads in the Inbox, and merge a pull request once its checks pass. It uses the app's own icon set and its strings (`approval_*`, `question_*`, `pr_checks_*`), so the labels match the app in all three languages. Beside the headline, a field of circles (the mark's own shape) shows the claim: most agents idle, a few coral and running, two amber and waiting on you. It is generated at build time and ships no JavaScript. Below the demo, the page walks the agent loop (start, watch, steer, review, ship), the MCP tools, remote machines and the phone, and the agents HinaCode runs. I only listed features whose docs say Shipped. Token usage per turn and the relay are still in progress, so they're out. ## Before and after ![Before: the dark site](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a1253412-a601-4d41-9300-2e05a372e701) ![After: hero](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c5d2a4c6-696b-45de-a127-f25dbe0a06ce) ![Approval in the demo](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d72c9358-6582-43c1-96b7-afae41d1bf20) ![Steering a running Codex turn](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/8d53ecb9-c1df-4eb3-aa2a-8db3b1744b29) ![Pull request watch hands a failing check to the agent](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a1026015-d190-439d-9e26-01517be04eaf) ![The agent loop, with static vignettes of the app](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/710c5567-8ac7-41ed-8e89-3107c8a3559f) ![Pricing](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c681a84a-0804-42ea-8322-10cf00045b68) ![Japanese](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/381bf780-d160-4678-9f69-e32b6e08502a) ![Mobile](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/4770ed2a-a6bf-4553-99ca-111ca5dbc700) ## Tradeoffs - The demo is a React island, which ships React (66 KB gzipped, plus 14 KB for the demo). A hand-rolled DOM version would be smaller, but the demo has real state (four threads, approvals, questions, a queue, merges), and React keeps `engine.ts` a plain reducer that is easy to extend with another thread. - The download button reads the latest release from the GitHub API in the browser and links the `.dmg`, `-setup.exe` or `.AppImage` directly. If the API is unreachable it falls back to the releases page. - Copy stays in the root catalogs under `site_` keys, so `messages.test.ts` keeps all three languages in step. The old site's keys are gone. ## Scope No dark site theme, docs pages or app store links. The phone app is still built from source, so the site describes it without linking a store. ## Verification Drove the demo in a browser through every path: allow, deny with a note, answer, steer, queue, merge, and the Vite thread's pull request watch. Checked desktop and mobile widths in English, Japanese and Traditional Chinese, and confirmed the download link resolves to the current release's `.dmg`. Ran `astro check` and the Workers deploy dry run. --- Need help on this PR? Tag @codesmith-bot with what you need.
